name: Bathsheba
title: Solomon's mother
summary: Bathsheba was first married to Uriah the Hittite, one of David's warriors. David saw her bathing, committed adultery with her, and had Uriah killed. After grief and repentance, she became David's queen and mother to Solomon, who inherited the throne with her help.

keyEvents.title: David's sin
keyEvents.description: David saw Bathsheba bathing from the roof, sent for her, and lay with her even though she was married.

keyEvents.title: The death of Uriah
keyEvents.description: When Bathsheba became pregnant, David tried to hide his sin. Finally, he sent Uriah to his death in battle.

keyEvents.title: Nathan's judgment
keyEvents.description: The prophet Nathan confronted David about his sin. David repented, but the child died as a result of the sin.

keyEvents.title: Solomon's Birth
keyEvents.description: David comforted Bathsheba, and she gave birth to Solomon. God sent word that He loved the child.

keyEvents.title: The Struggle for the Throne
keyEvents.description: When Adonijah tried to seize the throne, Bathsheba went to David and reminded him of his promise that Solomon would become king.
